title: test(plugin-form,console): pin the members of object-master-detail-form's seed pair and sections (objectui#8071 slice 15)
body:
Part of objectui#8071 — slice 15 of the block card. Refs: objectui#8071, objectui#8068.

Three `object-master-detail-form` keys move from `MEMBER_PIN_EXEMPTIONS` into `MEMBER_PINS`: **`initialData`**, **`initialValues`**, **`sections`**. Each pin constrains what the RENDERER reads, not what the registration declares.

**Clause-②: no** — this slice pins existing behaviour and changes no declaration surface.

## Merge base and the ledger readings, re-taken here

Branched from `origin/main` = `3a32a7cff88f0012cc1c333302747eaeb34b36b7`, which is also `git merge-base HEAD origin/main`. The ledger was re-counted at that base with a depth-aware, comment-and-string-aware direct-key counter whose own "non-property tokens at depth 0" bucket read `[]` on every record before and after, so the parse is clean and the counts below are readings. (`origin/main` has since moved to `489dd12e03`; its four commits touch neither the ledger nor `packages/plugin-form` — probed on the changed-file list, zero hits, with `packages/plugin-` lit at 4 on the same list as the control.)

| quantity | at the merge base | after this change |
|---|---|---|
| `MEMBER_PIN_EXEMPTIONS` direct keys | 13 | 10 |
| `MEMBER_PINS` direct keys | 78 | 81 |
| `MEMBER_PIN_EXEMPTION_CEILING` | 13 | 10 |

**I moved these three keys from exemptions to pins**, and nothing else moved in either direction — all four readings computed and compared, not asserted:

- left `MEMBER_PIN_EXEMPTIONS`: `object-master-detail-form.initialData`, `object-master-detail-form.initialValues`, `object-master-detail-form.sections`
- entered `MEMBER_PINS`: the same three
- entered exemptions: none · left pins: none

`NEWLY_JUDGED_UNPINNED_MEMBERS` is unchanged at 2 (`object-kanban`'s pair), and `record:related_list.actions` keeps its `NO_READ_SITE_TO_PIN` entry — neither family was touched and neither was re-measured here.

## Why the seed pair is ONE unit, re-read at my own merge base

The dispatch's three coordinates were re-read; two agree and one does not.

| site | what I read at `3a32a7cff8` |
|---|---|
| `MasterDetailFormSchema` in `packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx` | both spellings declared, `initialValues` and `initialData`, each typed as a record of string to any |
| the `parentSchema` memo in the same file | both forwarded, `initialValues: schema.initialValues,` and `initialData: schema.initialData,` |
| the `initialData` registration in `packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx` | calls it the "Alternate spelling of `initialValues` the renderer also reads", tells authors to prefer `initialValues`, and cites its read site by a line address |

So they are a declared alternate-spelling pair, and the precedence between them is the cell an author trips on. Pinning one alone would leave it stated nowhere, so both are pinned in one file, on one set of rows.

## ⚠️ The cited coordinate is ROTTED — reported, ⛔ not fixed here

The registration's citation points at `MasterDetailForm.tsx` line 602. That line today is a comment inside the objectui#6372 catch block that warns about a child schema that failed to load — nothing to do with either seed key. Settled over full history (this checkout is not shallow):

- the citation was written by `375efb4026` (2026-08-17), and at THAT commit the cited line really was `initialData: schema.initialData,` — the file was 736 lines long;
- the first commit at which the cited line is something else is `17ccec977c` (2026-08-24, PR objectui#6191, "decline to fetch a detail collection with no child object"), which inserted lines above it;
- the file is 1119 lines today and the two passes sit at lines 979-980.

So the coordinate has been false for about 25 days. ⛔ Not repaired in this PR: the registration `description` is another card's surface, and AGENTS.md commandment #11 bans a cross-file line address outright rather than asking for it to be re-pointed. Handed back on the card.

## What the pins say, and the two findings handed back

**`packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/masterDetailInitialMembers-8071.test.tsx`** (new, 7 rows). A member is a parent FIELD NAME and its value is that control's opening value. The two keys are chosen between as WHOLE OBJECTS — `schema.initialData || schema.initialValues` — never merged per member, so with both authored every `initialValues` member is dropped including the ones `initialData` says nothing about. Two rows no sibling pin can make: the seed reaches the PARENT LEG of the atomic batch and mints no child operation (a member naming a detail column seeds nothing, and the posted batch still carries exactly one op), and in `edit` mode with a `recordId` the fetched record REPLACES both keys wholesale, so a field the record omits opens empty rather than falling back to the seed.

**`packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/masterDetailSectionMembers-8071.test.tsx`** (new, 4 rows). Members are section objects shaping the PARENT half only — a member's `fields` are read as a SET so the object's order wins over the authored order, a member that resolves to no parent field is dropped heading and all, and the `details` collections keep their own columns through every row. Deliberately NOT re-asserted here, because they are owned by `objectFormSectionMembers-8071.test.tsx` next door: the collapse pair, the `name`-alone heading, the untitled bucket and the `description` blurb; the presentation routing is owned by `masterDetailFormTypeVocabulary.test.tsx`.

⚠️ **Finding 1 — an empty `initialData` shadows a populated `initialValues`.** `||` tests the OBJECT's truthiness and `{}` is truthy, so a designer's not-configured-yet empty object blanks every prefill with no warning and no empty state. Pinned as behaviour, ⛔ not fixed: fixing it is a renderer change and this card writes pins only. (The sibling block carries the identical read and the identical finding.)

⚠️ **Finding 2 — `fields` is declared ignored when `sections` is given, and it is not.** The registration for `object-master-detail-form.fields` reads "Ignored when `sections` is given — sections carry their own field lists". `ObjectForm` builds the parent field pool from `schema.fields` FIRST and a section resolves its members against that pool, so authoring both INTERSECTS them: a section member outside `fields` is dropped with no diagnostic, and a section whose every member is outside it disappears heading and all. This is a declared-contract divergence on a key that is still exempt and belongs to the next slice, so it is reported rather than repaired.

## Ablations — every pin, mutation proven ON DISK, restore proven by state

Each leg ran through `ablation-replace`, which refuses unless the anchor hits the declared number of times, the anchor count falls, the blob hash changes, and — on the restore leg — the blob equals the path's blob at `HEAD` with `git diff HEAD` empty. ⛔ No leg was judged by an editor's exit code, and no leg was a no-op: the substring trap this repo paid for three times today cannot hit a `--delete` leg, and the two replacement legs were checked by the same anchor-count evidence.

| # | mutation | rows that went RED | rows that stayed green |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | drop `initialData: schema.initialData,` from the `parentSchema` memo | 2, 3, 4 | 1, 5, 6, 7 |
| 2 | swap the create branch's whole-object choice for the per-member merge spelling | 3, 4 | the other five |
| 3 | drop `sections: schema.sections,` from the `parentSchema` memo | 1, 2, 3 | 4 (the control) |
| 4 | make `fields` really ignored when `sections` is given | 3 only | 1, 2, 4 |

Legs 1 and 3 are the reason these pins are taken at THIS block instead of delegated to the sibling's: the carrier is a hand-written key-by-key copy, so a dropped key leaves every declaration reading correct and the sibling's pins green. Leg 2 is the row a plausible improvement breaks. Leg 4 isolates finding 2 — with `fields` genuinely ignored, the fixture draws `ref, memo, memo`, the same field twice, which is what the declaration would actually mean.

⭐ No ablation refused a reading: every row predicted red went red, and each mutation's blast radius was exactly the rows that claim it. Blob hashes and the restore verdicts are in the run logs; the working tree is clean at every leg's end.

## Verification

Run through the container's shared heavy-verify lock where it was heavy; exit codes captured to disk before any pipe.

- **Type-check — run, and proven to SEE the changed files.** `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/plugin-form --filter=@object-ui/console`: 37 tasks successful, 0 failed. The package's first leg excludes tests by config, so the coverage claim is measured rather than assumed: `tsc -p packages/plugin-form/tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists both new pin files, and `tsc --noEmit -p apps/console/tsconfig.json --listFiles` lists the ledger file.
- **Tests.** `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/ apps/console/` — `Test Files 200 passed (200)`, `Tests 2094 passed | 1 skipped (2095)`. The ledger file alone: 199 passed.
- **Gates, all exit 0:** `check-changeset-presence` (reads the empty frontmatter as the explicit exemption), `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check-test-path-roots`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-no-major`.
- **Lint, narrowed and the narrowing measured.** The population is `eslint .` per package, read from each `package.json`. I ran `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the three changed files: 3 files, 0 errors, 5 warnings, all `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` — the same rule and the same shape the two sibling pin files already carry at `HEAD` (4 warnings), and neither package's lint script sets `--max-warnings`. The narrowing is sound because the config enables no type-aware linting: `projectService`, `parserOptions` and `project` all read zero in `eslint.config.js`, so this diff cannot move the verdict on any file it does not touch.
- **Published bytes — measured, not assumed.** Both packages were built, then their `files[]` corpora grepped. In `@object-ui/plugin-form` (63 published files) the change's markers read 0 while `MasterDetailForm` (13 files) and `initialData` (11 files) are lit; in `@object-ui/console` (3284 published files) the ledger's own symbols and both new basenames read 0 while `object-master-detail-form` (4) and `object-form` (12) are lit. Hence the empty-frontmatter changeset.

Scope was not refused: each of the three was measured as fitting, and the seed pair is one unit rather than two slices.
